coverage.ifAbsent: the scheduler takes novelty from the outcome tuple instead of edges, no coverageMap is asked for, and the scan writes no coverage.json

reproducer.ifAbsent: a finding carries no script, and the finding's inputs/ JSON stays the replayable artifact

stateful.ifAbsent: only entry points whose whole parameter graph is constructible from generated values are fuzzed

minimize.ifAbsent: the engine shrinks a finding itself, by removing arguments and reducing structure, and never calls minimize

sideEffects.ifAbsent: the side-effect policy does not apply, because the engine takes an invocation to change no external state

concurrent.ifAbsent: the engine runs one plugin instance for the whole scan

readiness.ifAbsent: the engine never calls ready, because the environment is the tree discovery already read and there is nothing to prove

mapping.spawn: no plugin process is running: the invocation is filed as a PluginLost finding with via "plugin-lost"
mapping.eof: the plugin closed its stdout with a call in flight: a PluginLost finding with via "plugin-lost", and the worker restarts
mapping.exited: the plugin ended itself with a call in flight: a ProcessExit finding with via "processExit", and the worker restarts
mapping.killed: the engine ended the plugin: a PluginLost finding with via "plugin-killed", attributed to the engine rather than to the target
mapping.noAnswer: the deadline passed with the request waiting: a Deadline finding with via "deadline", and the worker restarts
mapping.unusable-result: the handshake was not a document afz/1 reads: the plugin is reported lost with via "plugin-lost", a scan aborts with a profile error, and afz install-harness records nothing

rules.expectation: discover answers a discovery document that is an instance of the committed discovery schema.

defect.unverified: the reference plugin's scripted inventory is deserialized into afz_protocol::Discovery and re-serialized from it (crates/xtask/src/fake.rs:52), and docs/schema/afz-1/discovery.json sets no pattern, minLength or additionalProperties bound that a typed value of that struct can break, so no script answers discover with a document the committed schema rejects.

rules.expectation: Every target discover reports carries a non-empty id, and no id is reported twice.
Every target discover reports that is not constructible is also listed in skipped, so the inventory's counts add up.
A second discover with the same request on the same connection answers the same set of target ids as the first.

defect.unverified: the reference plugin answers every discover from one static Script.discovery value (crates/xtask/src/fake.rs:52) and no directive is keyed to a discover call, so no script makes the second call on a connection answer a different target id set than the first.

rules.expectation: A second plugin process answers its own discover with the same set of target ids the first process answered.

defect.unverified: both plugin processes are spawned from the same Check.launch with the same environment (crates/afz-conformance/src/lib.rs:1290) and the fake's inventory is one value rather than a function of the process, so no script makes one process answer a different target id set than the other.

rules.expectation: A plugin that declares readiness answers ready, and answers it ready once the host has started the service the harness manifest declares; a not-ready answer carries the plugin's own reason.
A plugin process that was only introduced and sent discover still answers prepare and invoke for a target id its own discover named.

defect.unverified: the only refusal the reference plugin can raise for prepare or invoke is requireDiscover, which never fires because the suite sends discover on the second process first (crates/afz-conformance/src/lib.rs:1299, pinned by crates/xtask/tests/conformance.rs:388), and directives are keyed to a per-process invocation index and a target id, both of which the second process shares with the first, so no script makes only the second process refuse.

rules.expectation: prepare answers {"ok":true,"materialized":…} or {"ok":false,"reason":…}; a target the plugin cannot build is a skip answer, never a JSON-RPC error.

defect.unverified: requireDiscover is the fake's only prepare refusal and the suite discovers on every connection before it prepares, while rpcError is read only when answering invoke (crates/xtask/src/fake.rs:43), so no script answers prepare with a JSON-RPC error.

rules.expectation: Every prepare response is an instance of the committed prepare-resp schema.

defect.unverified: prepare_resp builds a typed afz_protocol::PrepareResp from the request (crates/xtask/src/fake.rs:424) and docs/schema/afz-1/prepare-resp.json accepts exactly the two shapes that type serializes to, so no script answers prepare with a shape the committed schema rejects.

rules.expectation: invoke answers an outcome; a target fault travels as an outcome, never as a JSON-RPC error.
Every invoke response is an instance of the committed outcome schema.

defect.unverified: Directive.outcome is deserialized into afz_protocol::Outcome and re-serialized from it (crates/xtask/src/fake.rs:36), and docs/schema/afz-1/outcome.json is looser than that type, with no additionalProperties bound, no pattern, and no minimum on durationMs, so no script answers invoke with a document the schema rejects.

rules.expectation: Every outcome carries durationMs as a number the deadline oracle can read.
A plugin that declares coverage answers every ok to a collectCoverage request with a coverage digest.
A plugin that declares coverage answers coverageMap with at least one entry once it has been invoked.

defect.unverified: the fake answers coverageMap from a fixed 64-entry table no directive governs (crates/xtask/src/fake.rs:447), and the only selector that could silence the method is exit, which ends the process and so reports process-alive beside this rule.

rules.expectation: coverageMap answers a document that is an instance of the committed coverage-map schema.

defect.unverified: coverage_map builds a typed afz_protocol::CoverageMap (crates/xtask/src/fake.rs:447) and no script key governs the method, so no script answers coverageMap with a document the committed schema rejects.

rules.expectation: Every edge id an outcome's digest names is named by an entry of coverageMap.
A plugin that declares minimize answers a minimize request with a response that is an instance of the committed minimize-resp schema.

defect.unverified: minimize_resp answers every request from a typed afz_protocol::MinimizeResp built out of the request itself (crates/xtask/src/fake.rs:460), and no directive or top-level script key governs minimize, so no script makes a declared minimize capability answer wrongly or not at all.

rules.expectation: A plugin that declares reproducer answers a reproducer request for a discovered target with a response that is an instance of the committed reproducer-resp schema.

defect.unverified: reproducer_resp answers every request with one typed afz_protocol::ReproducerResp constant (crates/xtask/src/fake.rs:479), and no directive or top-level script key governs reproducer, so no script makes a declared reproducer capability answer wrongly or not at all.
